_itemised_edits: TWO FIELDS EDITED, DELIBERATELY, IN THE DATA ROOM REBUILD. (1) periodBar true -> false: the panel has NEVER read the page period — it has always had its own Window control — so the bar changed nothing below it. That was invisible until the Total column started naming the window it covers, at which point the bar read 'Feb 2026 - Jul 2026' while the total beside it read 'Apr 2023 - Sep 2026'. SectionFrame's own rule is that period:false means the page genuinely does not follow it. (2) subtitle: extended to say so, which is what that same rule requires of a page without a bar. Nothing else in this fixture moved, and the assertion bodies in verify-lifecycle-rename.mjs are unchanged — only the recorded baseline for these two fields.

THIRD FIELD EDITED, 2026-08-27, ITEMISED: data-room.cardTitles ["How these numbers are made"] -> []. The 'How these numbers are made' card is DELETED — the component too, not just its mount — because 'no text under the table' meant the page. Every fact it rendered is now in docs/matchday-api-facts.md under 'How the Growth / Lifecycle numbers are made': the three start dates (2023-03 / 2024-02 / 2023-04), Apple's Aug 2025 floor and one-year retention, App Units vs user-installs, the aggregate-ratio caveat, the open month, and the 201 fake users / 33,809 fake rows. The assertion BODY in verify-lifecycle-rename.mjs is unchanged; only the recorded baseline for this one field moved, and it moved to empty because the card no longer exists.
